title: Neon Plasma Slot Machine
description: A surreal steampunk-style plasma globe functions as the central reel of a vintage slot machine. Inside the glowing glass sphere, vibrant neon tendrils in pink, yellow, and cyan form abstract leaf and floral patterns around a central pink lock-shaped core with two glowing green eyes.
prompt: A vintage wooden slot machine with a large glass plasma globe on top, the interior filled with glowing neon pink, yellow, and cyan plasma tendrils forming floral and leaf patterns around a central glowing pink lock with two bright green eyes, set against a white background with floating black spheres, whimsical surreal style, vibrant colors, detailed digital painting
